tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Architect – B2C E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend specialist with 5+ years delivering large-scale B2C e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, micro-services and headless REST/OCC APIs, driving seamless PIM/ERP/MDM integrations and PWA enablement. Proven record of designing data pipelines, API migrations and production support while bridging business and IT through techno-functional analysis and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Architect – Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited by your vision to lead the next generation of B2C commerce on Salesforce. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless APIs, PWA integration and large-scale data pipelines that align perfectly with your technical roadmap.

bullets.label: **Headless API Development**
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST web services on SAP Commerce Cloud, enabling headless storefronts and third-party consumption across global B2C channels.

bullets.label: **PWA & Front-end Enablement**
bullets.text: Integrated Progressive Web Applications with SAP Commerce back-end, delivering fast, responsive B2C experiences comparable to modern composable storefronts.

bullets.label: **Enterprise Integration**
bullets.text: Built robust PIM-to-Hybris pipelines and API migrations, synchronizing product data between ERP, MDM and external systems for seamless B2C catalog management.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Leadership**
bullets.text: Collaborated with business owners and international technical teams to translate requirements into functional specs, user stories and production-ready solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background can drive your B2C initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: I admire your commitment to redefining B2C commerce through a composable, AI-driven architecture. Your focus on SFRA and modern storefronts aligns with my passion for headless solutions and API-first design. Joining your team would let me leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to accelerate your Salesforce B2C vision and deliver differentiated customer experiences at scale.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and headless API expertise to accelerate your Salesforce B2C platform and drive innovative B2C experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud architect with 5+ years of B2C experience at Rockwell and Shell. I’m keen to discuss how my headless API and PWA expertise can add value to your Salesforce B2C initiatives. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Architect – Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Technical Lead
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Architect – Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Technical Lead role. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience delivering B2C solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, with strong expertise in headless APIs, PWA integration and enterprise data pipelines. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.
